verdict.rationale: Clerk documents Admin Logs, an audit trail of admin actions in the Dashboard (clerk-docs-54), and a now-public GET /v1/logs endpoint for programmatically retrieving Application Logs events (clerk-docs-71). Together these give a pull-based way to capture and export admin and auth activity. One community user reported being unable to trace who changed a console setting (clerk-comm-2), but it is unclear whether that predates Admin Logs, so it lowers confidence rather than creating a dispute. Missing for 10: any evidence the logs are tamper-evident (immutability or integrity guarantees), native SIEM streaming or connectors (e.g. Splunk/Datadog log drains), documented coverage of authentication events within the audit log, retention and export details, and independent corroboration.
